_notes: Sensirion SGP30 indoor air quality (eCO2 and TVOC) at 0x58 (fixed). Detection: get_feature_set (0x202F, 10 ms) - one word with its Sensirion CRC-8 (:crc8w) whose top 4 bits are the product type, 0 for the SGP30. Init: iaq_init (0x2003, 10 ms). Poll (1 s - measure_iaq must be called once a second for the chip's own dynamic baseline compensation): measure_iaq (0x2008), wait 12 ms, read eCO2 (ppm) and TVOC (ppb), each word followed by a CRC (not checked). For the first 15 s after iaq_init it reports 400 ppm and 0 ppb. setBaseline restores the IAQ baseline: TVOC baseline, then eCO2 baseline (the reverse of the order get_iaq_baseline returns them; the record has no action to read the baseline). setHumidity: absolute humidity for compensation, 8.8 fixed point in g/m3, 0 turns it off.

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-23): the lone 0x99 is NACKed (half a 16-bit command); the serial number, feature set and measurements are unchanged
